Ad-free Tamil films on your TV, from legal sources only: TMDB for lists and posters, official YouTube trailers and songs, and links into the streaming apps you already pay for.

**Android TV:** download `padam.apk`. On the TV, install the free Downloader app, type the link to `padam.apk`, and choose Install. The newest build is always at https://github.com/javajaga-usa/Padam/releases/download/tv-latest/padam.apk

**Any other smart TV:** download `padam-web.zip` on a computer at home and unzip it. Then double-click **Start Padam** (`.bat` on Windows, `.command` on Mac) and open **padam.local** in the TV's browser. Needs Node.js 18 or newer.

What's in it:
- Home with a rotating Featured banner, Top 10, In theatres, streaming, genres and classics
- Film pages with cast, age rating, where to stream, trailers and songs
- Search with voice, recent searches, decade filters and sorting
- My List, Recently viewed and actor pages
- YouTube plays inside Padam or in the YouTube app (ad-free with YouTube Premium)
